Nothing runs after the merge (spec v3 Testing 3): no post-merge implementer round. Single-issue tree, no child issues, no plan or spec file in the repository. Rebase only if GitHub reports CONFLICTING; re-run a flaky job in place with `legion gh -- run rerun <run-id> --failed`, never by pushing. No deferrals: the only permitted follow-up field is `Fast-follow: none`.
concerns: WORKSPACE TRAP: the working copy `@` carries a tracked 0-byte `.omp/config.yml` (harness-created, not on main, no .gitignore in the repo). It must never reach any commit or the PR (acceptance 1: the diff is smoke/legsmoke-115.md plus .legion/ only). Every phase commits with a path-scoped `jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" split -m '<msg>' <path>` from the working copy so `.omp/config.yml` stays in `@` as the remainder. Never `jj new` from `@`, never `jj describe @`, never `jj commit` without paths in this workspace. Held on LEGSMOKE-3 and LEGSMOKE-104.

BOOKMARK TRAP: after every `jj split`, jj moves bookmark legion/LEGSMOKE-115 onto the remainder commit `@` (the .omp/ remainder). Before every push re-point it with `jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" bookmark set legion/LEGSMOKE-115 -r @- --allow-backwards` (the bare form exits 1: `Refusing to move bookmark backwards or sideways`; verified on jj 0.45.1, flag `-B, --allow-backwards`). Then `jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" git push --bookmark legion/LEGSMOKE-115`. Origin already has legion/LEGSMOKE-115 carrying only the plan-handoff commits (.legion/plan.json). In this workspace the bookmark had been pre-provisioned untracked at the .omp/ remainder `@`; the second planner re-pointed it onto the plan commit (`bookmark set -r legion/LEGSMOKE-115@origin --allow-backwards`) and made it track @origin, so `jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" bookmark list --all-remotes legion/LEGSMOKE-115` shows one target with @git and @origin in step. A bare `bookmark track` on a sideways local bookmark would have produced a conflicted bookmark.

TOOLING TRAP: in the harness bash tool, bare `cmp` resolves to a shadowing aux util that fails on process substitution (`Illegal seek`, exit 2). Use `/usr/bin/cmp` for every byte comparison. Verified by the planner: positive -> silent exit 0; one-character negative -> `differ: byte 84, line 1`, exit 1.

`gh` on PATH is the `legion gh --` shim; every spec `gh ...` command is `legion gh -- ... --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke` (the workspace has no gh default repo). The shim refuses `pr merge`; the merge queue merges.

No `.legion/architect.json` preceded this plan (single-issue tree); plan.json is the first ledger entry.

The ancestry check before each push must show only main -> plan handoff (3536b821) -> plan handoff (revision) -> this issue's commits.

reviewerSteps.cmd: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && legion handoff write --phase review --data '<json>' && test -f "$LEGION_WORKSPACE/.legion/review.json" && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" split -m 'review: record handoff' .legion/review.json && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" bookmark set legion/LEGSMOKE-115 -r @- --allow-backwards && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" git push --bookmark legion/LEGSMOKE-115 && legion handoff complete --summary '<two sentences: verdict at $H; the .legion/-free head is needed for approval>'

reviewerSteps.do: Approval round (after the implementer's .legion/ deletion push): verify the clean head, then one APPROVE naming it by SHA
reviewerSteps.cmd: H=<legion-free-sha>; legion gh -- api "repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/git/trees/$H?recursive=1" --jq '.tree[] | select(.type=="blob") | .path'; legion gh -- pr diff <n> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke --name-only; legion gh -- pr view <n> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke --json additions,deletions; legion gh -- api repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/commits/$H/check-runs --jq '.check_runs[].conclusion'; legion gh -- api --method POST repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/pulls/<n>/reviews --input /tmp/legsmoke-115-approve.json  # {commit_id: $H, event: 'APPROVE', body: 'Approved at $H ...<footer>', comments: []}
reviewerSteps.expect: Tree is exactly the seven main paths plus smoke/legsmoke-115.md — no .legion/, no .omp/, no .fail-me. `--name-only` prints exactly `smoke/legsmoke-115.md`. `{"additions":1,"deletions":0}`. Check-run conclusions print only `success`. The gate no longer applies once .legion/ is gone: write no review.json for this round; report with `legion handoff complete` alone.

mergerSteps.do: Resolve threads (none expected), capture the tip once, and prove nothing but retro sits above the approved head
mergerSteps.cmd: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && legion threads resolve --pr <n> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke; TIP=$(legion gh -- pr view <n> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke --json headRefOid --jq .headRefOid); echo $TIP; jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" git fetch && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" diff --from <approved-sha> --to $TIP --summary; jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" diff --from <approved-sha> --to $TIP --summary '~docs/solutions'; legion gh -- pr view <n> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke --json state,mergeStateStatus,reviews,commits; legion gh -- api repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/commits/$TIP/check-runs --jq '.check_runs[].conclusion'
mergerSteps.expect: No `left open` line and exit 0. First summary lists only docs/solutions/* additions (retro) or is empty (quote as `no file changes above the approved head`); the second prints nothing. Reviews contain APPROVED pinned to the .legion/-free head; only retro's commit follows it; check-runs only success. Anything else above the approved head: tell the architect the head must return to review; do not publish.

mergerSteps.do: Acceptance 3 at the PR head (spec v3 Testing 3): fetch smoke/legsmoke-115.md from the tip with the contents API, byte-check it, and record the response in the PR body's E2E section in place (acceptance3LineForMerger)
mergerSteps.cmd: legion gh -- api "repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/contents/smoke/legsmoke-115.md?ref=$TIP" --jq '{sha,size,path}'; legion gh -- api "repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/contents/smoke/legsmoke-115.md?ref=$TIP" --jq .content | base64 -d | /usr/bin/cmp - <(printf 'LEGSMOKE-115 Legion smoke exercise (2026-09-13T09:52:01Z). Safe to merge; throwaway.\n'); echo cmp=$?; legion gh -- pr view <n> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke --json body --jq .body > /tmp/legsmoke-115-pr-body.md; <append acceptance3LineForMerger with <tip-sha>=$TIP to the E2E section>; legion gh -- pr edit <n> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke --body-file /tmp/legsmoke-115-pr-body.md
mergerSteps.expect: {"sha":"d16664adc2edd530cbbece87fa19fa27fc75de1b","size":85,"path":"smoke/legsmoke-115.md"}; cmp prints nothing, cmp=0. Editing the PR body changes no commit, so the approval stands. The body file lives under /tmp, never inside the workspace.

mergerSteps.do: Publish READY to the merge queue; never merge
mergerSteps.cmd: envoy_publish to the project's controller topic — the one named in the merger's own `Legion addressing` system-prompt line (this deployment: notifications.role.legion-sjawhar16-controller; never hand-format another): `READY #<n> at <tip-sha> (approved at <approved-sha>) for LEGSMOKE-115 (<pr url>)` with the two --summary outputs, the PR body's CI/Threads/E2E/Fast-follow/Chain facts, and the acceptance-3 contents API response at <tip-sha>. On a 404 no-holder, publish the same READY to the architect's topic and stay idle.
mergerSteps.expect: The queue merges that exact head under its own authority and reports the merge commit to the architect (spec v3 Testing 3). Then `legion handoff complete`. Nothing runs after the merge.

legionDeletionAfterCleanReview: cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && rm -rf .legion && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" status  # expect D .legion/plan.json, D .legion/implement.json, D .legion/test.json, D .legion/review.json (whatever exists), plus A .omp/config.yml
cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" file list -r @- .legion  # prints nothing on stdout (jj warns on stderr)
cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" diff --from main@origin --to @- --summary  # exactly: A smoke/legsmoke-115.md
cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" bookmark set legion/LEGSMOKE-115 -r @- --allow-backwards && jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" git push --bookmark legion/LEGSMOKE-115

Wait for checks at the new head, update the PR body CI line in place (implementer step 10), and tell the architect the .legion/-free head SHA; the reviewer approves that SHA by name. Write no .legion/implement.json for this round; report with `legion handoff complete` alone.
retroAfterApproval: Commit exactly one file under docs/solutions/<category>/<slug>.md with `jj -R "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" split -m 'docs: retro for LEGSMOKE-115' docs/solutions`, `bookmark set legion/LEGSMOKE-115 -r @- --allow-backwards`, push. Nothing under .legion/, nothing else. The approval stands; the tree goes to the merger.
laterImplementerRounds.rebaseOnlyIfConflicting: Only when `legion gh -- pr view <n> --repo sjawhar/legion-smoke --json mergeStateStatus` is CONFLICTING (it should not be: no unmerged branch touches smoke/legsmoke-115.md). Then follow the skill's fingerprint procedure verbatim (`jj rebase -s 'roots(main@origin..@)' -d main@origin`, fingerprint before and after with the single fileset '~(.legion | docs/solutions)'); post one `rebase <old> -> <new>; fingerprint <before> -> <after>; unchanged|changed` comment with the Legion footer. After the rebase the .omp/ remainder is still `@`; the bookmark still goes to @- --allow-backwards.
laterImplementerRounds.afterMerge: Nothing (spec v3 Testing 3). The merge queue reports the merge commit to the architect and the architect's sign-off names it; no worker is sent back and no post-merge contents API call on main is made. No production deploy exists for this repository; the merge commit carrying smoke/legsmoke-115.md onto main is the production observation.

acceptance1Invariant: At the tested head (implementer/tester heads) the PR diff touches only smoke/legsmoke-115.md and paths under .legion/. At the reviewer-approved head the PR diff is exactly smoke/legsmoke-115.md with additions 1, deletions 0. Any other path at any head (in particular .omp/config.yml, .fail-me, README.md, workflows) fails the phase; the implementer removes it (spec Errors row 3); nothing is downgraded.
nonGoals: no plan or spec file in the repository (plan lives in .legion/plan.json and the Dispatch document)
no README, workflow, or existing smoke-note changes
no .fail-me at any head; the negative control runs only in a temp dir outside the workspace
no second note or larger diff (spec Rejected row 1)
no worker merges; the queue merges
no post-merge verification round: the merge commit the queue reports is the acceptance-3 observation (spec v3 Testing 3)
